purpose: Support the SCB-style hierarchical consistency layer without changing the production migration model or consuming new holdouts.

method.sameCountyLeg: Municipal same-county inflows will be consistency-adjusted against same-county outflows across all Norrbotten municipalities.
method.otherCountyLeg: Municipal other-Sweden flows will be reconciled to a Norrbotten county-level migration model before any external holdout evaluation.
method.internationalLeg: Municipal immigration/emigration will later be reconciled through county and national totals.

governance: These geographies are support data only. They are not independent validation municipalities and must not be counted as holdout evidence.
